description: Retrieve a UCP checkout session by ID. Returns the current state of the checkout. Use ONLY for a checkout session created with ucp_create_checkout (Universal Commerce Protocol); for the standard flow (create_cart, preview_checkout, complete_checkout) do not call this tool. Checkout guide: read the MCP resource trusteed://guides/checkout.

agent_key.description: Sandbox credential from `create_sandbox_key`. Use this when your client cannot set an `Authorization: Bearer` header.

meta.description: UCP request metadata. meta['ucp-agent'].profile = URL of the platform profile; it must be an https URL without credentials (at most 2048 characters).

name: ucp_get_checkout
